newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH TO RAISE CREDIT, DEPO RATES AUG 18.
newsitem.headline: BPH TO RAISE CREDIT, DEPO RATES AUG 18.

text.p: Bank Przemyslowo Handlowy SA will raise its base credit rate by two points to 24 percent and raise its deposit rates by an average of one point as of August 18, the bank said in a Wednesday statement.

It said current interest on one month deposits was 15.75 percent, on three-month deposits 17 percent and on six month deposits 17.5 percent. Details of changes on various types of terms deposits would be announced later, it said.

The BPH decision follows the National Bank of Poland's official interest rate rise of two and 2.5 percent to 27 and 24.5 percent for the lombard and discount rates respectively on August 4. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
